test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who is the first Indian to participate in a Super Heavyweight Boxing event in the 2020 Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satish Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satish Kumar:-**

 
 
• **He was the first Indian boxer to participate in the Super Heavyweight (+91 kg) category at the 2020 Olympic Games in Tokyo.**
 
• He qualified for the Olympics by reaching the semifinals of the Asia/Oceania Qualifiers in Amman, Jordan in April 2019.
 
• In the Olympics, Kumar defeated Ricardo Brown of Jamaica in his opening bout but lost to Bakhodir Jalolov of Uzbekistan in the quarterfinals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amit Panghal:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian Army Junior Commissioned Officer (JCO) and an amateur boxer. **
 
• He won a silver medal at the 2019 AIBA World Boxing Championships. He also won a gold medal at the 2018 Asian Games.
 
• He was awarded the Arjuna Award in 2022. 
 
 
 
• **Sakshi Chaudhary:-**
 
 
• **She is an Indian amateur boxer who hails from Bhiwani, Haryana. **
 
• She is a three-time World Boxing Champion and an eight-time National Champion.
 
• She has been inspired by Olympic bronze medalist Vijender Singh to take up boxing.
